SELECT 
  order_id,
  AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as order_avg,
  AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) - (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) 
    FROM Order_Items
  ) as avg_difference
FROM Order_Items
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) 
  FROM Order_Items
) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN avg_difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
  avg_difference DESC
LIMIT 10
